questions.questionText: I stand tall but never walk. I have branches but no arms, and birds often call me home. What am I?
I have four legs but cannot run. People sit on me when they need to rest outdoors. What am I?
I wear three colors and stand beside the road. I tell vehicles when to stop and go. What am I?
I have stripes but am not a tiger. People walk across me to reach the other side of the road. What am I?
I bloom in different colors and attract butterflies, but I cannot move from where I grow. What am I?
I swallow letters but never eat. People drop their envelopes inside me to send them away. What am I?
I have a face and hands but cannot smile or clap. You can find me showing the time outdoors. What am I?
I help you find your way around a place. I display names and directions but never speak. What am I?
I collect rainwater on the ground and reflect the sky, but I disappear when the sun dries me up. What am I?
I am built by tiny architects using twigs and leaves. I may be hidden in a tree and serve as a home for baby birds. What am I?
